one_liner: Lauri Markkanen shoots 89.2 percent from the free-throw line -- the best mark among the bigs in this set -- at 25 points per 36 minutes.
three_things: 89.2 percent from the line is guard-grade touch from a power forward.
25 points per 36 with 36.8 percent from three.
7.7 rebounds per 36 and only 2 assists: a scorer's role, not a hub's.
